caption: The drawing features an ornate, freestanding oval mirror mounted on an elaborate bronze or brass base. The mirror is held in place by two vertical supports ending in sculpted animal heads, possibly resembling horses or dogs, on either side of the oval frame. The frame of the mirror itself is edged with a repeating decorative pattern, and a small crest-like element is positioned at its top center. The mirror assembly is supported by a decorative, openwork circular tray or dish, which rests on a single stem that transitions into an intricately designed, wide, and sturdy base with scroll-like, organic motifs. The entire object is rendered in varying shades of gold and bronze, with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest three-dimensionality and metallic sheen. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white or light beige, directing the viewer's attention solely to the detailed mirror structure.
title: Dressing Mirror
